newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL rubber ends down on thin volume.
newsitem.headline: KL rubber ends down on thin volume.

text.p: Malaysia's rubber market ended down as players were concerned over a volatile ringgit and sought rubber at prices lower than quoted by producers, traders said on Wednesday.
"There was hardly any movement today, I guess the trend will be the same until end of this week," said a trader.
At the close, the RSS1 for September buyer was officially quoted at 247.50 cents (94 U.S. cents) a kg, down 1.50 cents from Tuesday's close.
